"""D-36 Stage 5B: cross-check the 3 overlap days (2016-08-29~2016-08-31) between
the Stage 5A merged locked-window price file and the independent local
data/krx_daily.sqlite3 database. Prints ONLY match/mismatch flags, never the
actual price values.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

MERGED_PRICE = Path("data/locked_window/index_tsmom_v1/price_merged.csv")
SQLITE_DB = Path("data/krx_daily.sqlite3")
SYMBOL = "069500"
OVERLAP_DATES = ["2016-08-29", "2016-08-30", "2016-08-31"]

# CSV korean columns -> sqlite3 columns for the fields both sources carry
FIELD_MAP = {
    "시가": "open",
    "고가": "high",
    "저가": "low",
    "종가": "close",
    "거래량": "volume",
}


def main() -> None:
    merged = pd.read_csv(MERGED_PRICE, parse_dates=["일자"])
    merged["일자"] = merged["일자"].dt.date

    conn = sqlite3.connect(SQLITE_DB)
    all_match = True
    print("=== Stage 5B: sqlite3 겹침구간(3일) 대조 결과 ===")
    for d in OVERLAP_DATES:
        target = pd.Timestamp(d).date()
        row_csv = merged[merged["일자"] == target]
        cur = conn.execute(
            "SELECT open, high, low, close, volume FROM daily_prices "
            "WHERE symbol = ? AND trade_date = ?",
            (SYMBOL, d),
        )
        row_db = cur.fetchone()

        if row_csv.empty:
            print(f"  {d}: CSV 측 데이터 없음 (SKIP)")
            continue
        if row_db is None:
            print(f"  {d}: sqlite3 측 데이터 없음 (SKIP)")
            continue

        csv_vals = {k: int(row_csv.iloc[0][k]) for k in FIELD_MAP}
        db_vals = dict(zip(["시가", "고가", "저가", "종가", "거래량"], row_db))

        mismatches = [k for k in FIELD_MAP if csv_vals[k] != db_vals[k]]
        if mismatches:
            all_match = False
            print(f"  {d}: 불일치 필드 = {mismatches}")
        else:
            print(f"  {d}: 전 필드(시가/고가/저가/종가/거래량) 일치")

    print()
    print("결과:", "PASS (전체 일치)" if all_match else "FAIL (불일치 발견)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
